metadata.title: Cross-Cloud Governance

props.name: capability

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Multi-cloud management layers, centralized policy engines, cross-provider identity, configuration, and monitoring systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing policy equivalence, risk normalization, and assurance consistency across heterogeneous cloud environments.

props.name: depends-on

props.name: attack-tactic

props.name: attack-tactic

props.name: attack-technique

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Cloud infrastructure discovery leveraged to identify governance inconsistencies.

metadata.remarks: Cross-Cloud Governance defines the trust properties required to ensure that security policy intent, enforcement, and assurance remain consistent across multiple cloud providers. This pattern recognizes that multi-cloud risk often emerges from governance and semantic gaps rather than individual platform failures.

components.title: Policy Intent Normalization
components.description: Ensures security policies express consistent intent across heterogeneous cloud providers.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security policy intent is normalized to avoid provider-specific ambiguity.

components.title: Governance Drift Detection
components.description: Detects divergence in governance posture between cloud environments.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cross-cloud governance drift is detected and surfaced for remediation.

components.title: Centralized Cloud Risk Visibility
components.description: Provides unified visibility into security risk across all cloud providers.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security risk across providers is visible in a single governance context.
